answer: Style fingerprinting collapses cloned agents into a single earning seat. Every epoch the protocol gives each seat a fresh mesa, an open-ended design problem with no single right answer, and extracts a pigment from the reply: a vector of word choice, reasoning order and error habits. Seats whose pigments cluster within a tight radius are merged into one reef, and a reef earns one seat's reward however many members it holds. To stay out of a reef, each fake needs a genuinely distinct model lineage doing fresh, divergent work on every new mesa.
